extraction.Name: Alice Brown
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (tribe not stated)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not desire it, because she did not want to pay taxes on it; that she was informed that it was necessary for her to accept it, and pay the taxes, and she accepted same
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the half section to pay the taxes on this land, to McKinley and Allen, of Sioux Falls, South Dakota, through their agent, for the sum of $600.00, and, in 1924, these men foreclosed on her land
extraction.Buyer: McKinley and Allen, of Sioux Falls, South Dakota, through their agent, for the sum of $600.00; foreclosed in 1924
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: in 1919, the taxes being behind, she mortgaged the half section to pay the taxes on this land
extraction.Occupation/Income: husband's only source of income is the money he get from leasing the childrens' land
extraction.NOTES: Allotment covers the W½ of Sec. 33, T. 37N. R. 36W., 6th P.M., in South Dakota; health is poor, suffering from rheumatism and gall stone troubles; husband's sight is failing; three minor children to support; in 1918, her four boys joined the United States Army, two serving overseas, one of these got killed in France, and the other two served in the United States; has never received any help from the County or the United States Government; document number No. 4447; subscribed and sworn November 16, 1928
